maintenanceInfo: Stored reports for the visible page. This view does not establish the health of the whole installation.
sourcesInfo: Enabled enrollment allows a source to report. It does not mean a service is healthy.
logsInfo: Browse incidents and retained deployment diagnostics for this installation.
pageScope: Only this page is shown; there is no installation-wide health summary.
pageLimit: Page history is limited. Return to the first page to begin again.
unavailable: Operations data could not be refreshed. Previously received status is shown as unknown.
pendingRead: A previous read is still pending. Refresh becomes available when it ends.
denied: Operations data is available only to a current active administrator.
emptyObservationsInfo: Collection may not be configured, or this page has no stored reports.
emptySourcesInfo: No enrolled source was returned for this page.
emptyIncidentsInfo: This does not establish that every service is healthy.
emptyEventsInfo: Receipts may not have been collected or may have left the retained history window.
identityUnchecked: Installed identity has not been reported.

deploymentStages.switch_intent: Route switch started. Verify which Web generation the ingress serves before retrying.
deploymentStages.switch_acknowledged: Ingress acknowledged the route switch. Check public health and the accepted Web generation before proceeding.
deploymentStages.rollback_intent: Route restoration started. Verify ingress and health of the retained Web generation.
deploymentStages.accepted: The controller confirmed the route and health of the selected Web generation.
deploymentStages.rolled_back: The controller restored the retained Web generation after the candidate failed its public health check.
deploymentStages.rejected: The route stayed on the retained Web generation. Check candidate startup, retained health and ingress admission.

reasons.core_configuration_invalid: Core configuration failed validation. Check the runtime profile and secret-file references.
reasons.core_startup_failed: Core failed during startup. Check the preceding host diagnostics for this process.
reasons.core_startup_timeout: Core exceeded its startup deadline. Check database, queue initialization and network availability.
reasons.core_db_role_rejected: Core rejected its PostgreSQL runtime role. Check runtime grants and the migration ledger.
reasons.core_producer_failed: Core's queue producer failed. Check the queue schema, runtime grants and database availability.
reasons.core_database_failed: Core lost its PostgreSQL connection. Check reachability, connection limits and database health.
reasons.core_listener_failed: Core could not bind its listener. Check the configured address, port and port ownership.
reasons.core_readiness_failed: Core failed its database or queue readiness probe. Check both dependencies.
reasons.core_readiness_timeout: Core's readiness probe timed out. Check database latency and queue health.
reasons.core_transport_failed: Core's HTTP transport failed. Check the runtime listener and host resource limits.
reasons.core_drain_failed: Core reported a shutdown step failure. Check request, queue and database cleanup.
reasons.core_drain_timeout: Core exceeded its shutdown deadline. Inspect host diagnostics before recycling the process.
